name: content-identity
body: The content-identity key folding the HEAD sha and the working-tree/index/untracked content, recorded in `graph.jsonl` line 1 and in the DB's `Scan` row. It is the freshness rule's key and the seed guard's equivalence key. A re-anchored `graph.jsonl` can carry a new key while the DB's `Scan` row still carries the old one, which is how a worktree scan fast-paths without advancing the shared store.
